title: Limit database and collection names in DBOperationArgs and CollOperationArgs
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts (lines 11-18), replace the plain z.string() for database and collection with limited strings that follow MongoDB naming rules. database: min 1, max 63 characters, and none of / \ . " $ space or the null character. collection: min 1, max 255 characters, must not start with "system." unless the tool explicitly allows it, and must not contain $ or the null character. Put the regexes and error messages next to the existing ALLOWED_* constants in src/tools/args.ts and follow their style. Add tests in tests/unit covering valid names, overlong names and forbidden characters. Same feature branch as task 1; no deployment in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm vitest run --project unit-and-integration tests/unit/args.test.ts` passes, including tests that reject a 64-character database name, a database name containing '.', and a collection name containing '$' or the null character
`git grep -n 'database: z.string().describe' src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts` and `git grep -n 'collection: z.string().describe' src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts` return no match

verificationMethod.description: The reviewer checks the mongodbTool.ts and args.ts diff against MongoDB's documented namespace limits and confirms the new unit tests exist. The reviewer runs `pnpm vitest run --project unit-and-integration`; expected result: the whole suite passes, and integration tests that use real database/collection names still work.

rootCause.description: CollOperationArgs declares database and collection as unconstrained z.string(), so any length or character reaches the driver as a namespace, including names the server would reject or that point at system collections.
